papers.title: Single track and single layer formation in selective laser melting of niobium solid solution alloy
papers.abstract: Selective laser melting (SLM) was employed to fabricate Nb-37Ti-13Cr-2Al-1Si (at%) alloy, using pre-alloyed powders prepared by plasma rotating electrode processing (PREP). A series of single tracks and single layers under different processing parameters was manufactured to evaluate the processing feasibility by SLM, including laser power, scanning speed, and hatch distance. Results showed that continuous single tracks could be fabricated using proper laser powers and scanning velocities. Both the width of a single track and its penetration depth into a substrate increased with an increase of the linear laser beam energy density (LED), i.e., an increase of the laser power and a decrease of the scanning speed. Nb, Ti, Si, Cr, and Al elements distributed heterogeneously over the melt pool in the form of swirl-like patterns. An excess of the hatch distance was not able to interconnect neighboring tracks. Under improper processing parameters, a balling phenomenon occurred, but could be eliminated with an increased LED. This work testified the SLM-processing feasibility of Nb-based alloy and promoted the application of SLM to the manufacture of niobium-based alloys.

summary_en.motivation: To assess the feasibility of selective laser melting for processing a Nb-37Ti-13Cr-2Al-1Si alloy.
summary_en.method: Single tracks and single layers were fabricated with varying laser power, scanning speed, and hatch distance to evaluate processing parameters.
summary_en.result: Continuous single tracks were achieved under appropriate parameters, and balling defects were eliminated by increasing linear energy density.
summary_en.validation: Experimental fabrication and characterization of track morphology confirmed the processing window.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅关注临床脱位风险，未涉及任何生物力学建模或应力分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical outcome study on dislocation risk after THA for femoral neck fracture, with no biomechanical modeling, no FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估现代假体是否降低了股骨颈骨折全髋置换后的脱位风险。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析临床数据，比较不同假体类型的脱位率。
summary_zh.result: 现代假体并未显著降低脱位风险，后外侧入路脱位率仍较高。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床病例的回顾性统计分析。

summary_en.motivation: To determine whether modern implant designs reduce dislocation risk after total hip arthroplasty for displaced femoral neck fracture.
summary_en.method: Retrospective clinical review comparing dislocation rates among different implant types and surgical approaches.
summary_en.result: Modern implants did not significantly lower dislocation risk; posterior approach still associated with higher dislocation rates.
summary_en.validation: Clinical retrospective cohort analysis with statistical comparison.
